statement: The monodromy of the eight ordinary circles tangent to three labelled general circles is the inner holomorph D₈ ⋊ Inn(D₈), where D₈ denotes the dihedral group of order 8. It has order 32 and GAP identifier SmallGroup(32,49).

answer.qualification: Attributed to Harris (1982). The original article has not been directly inspected for the exact group description; the recorded identification and permutation realization were checked through Zeng’s exposition. The action uses ordinary circle coefficients, without adjoining chosen square roots of the squared radii.

source.location: Apollonius application; exact page or theorem locator not yet verified in the original article
source.version: Published article, Transactions of the American Mathematical Society 271(2) (1982), 611–638

scope: Labelled input circles parameterized by their ordinary conic coefficients, without adjoining chosen square roots of their squared radii.
notes: Harris (1982) is the attributed original source and the sole bibliography reference for this result. Direct inspection of the original article and its exact result locator remains pending. Zeng’s 2025 exposition was used as a verification aid for the inner-holomorph description and the identification SmallGroup(32,49), not as the original attribution. The stored permutations give a transitive realization of that group; their labels are abstract solution labels. Do not confuse this monodromy action with McKean’s set-theoretic (C₂)^3 duality action or the group after base change to chosen radii.
